baseline.provider_tools: Resolve exact selected catalog artifact; this document authorizes no tool-version change.

status_semantics.SOURCE_PRESENT_REQUIRES_LIVE_QUALIFICATI: Source path exists; not a claim every case is implemented or executable.
status_semantics.REQUIRES_REMOTE_ROUTE_QUALIFICATION: Remote support/implementation must be independently established.
status_semantics.REQUIRES_INSTALLATION_SCOPE_QUALIFICATIO: Legacy or partial source cannot grant current installation authority.
status_semantics.REQUIRES_SCOPE_SPECIFIC_QUALIFICATION: Check exact local/remote scope; no blanket support claim.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_CURRENT_PRODUCT_CONTRACT: Current selected pairing artifacts not admitted to this lifecycle route.
status_semantics.DEDICATED_ROUTE_NOT_CONFIRMED: Target feature has no confirmed dedicated shipped execution route.
status_semantics.NOT_RUN: No recorded public0.4.10 live execution evidence; source/debug/artifact evidence cannot replace it.
status_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: Explicitly explained interface applicability only; not an exemption for unsupported required features.
status_semantics.LIVE_PASS: Only a case-bound actual public execution receipt plus independent readback may earn this result.
status_semantics.FAIL: Actual case failed; retain evidence and classify next action.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Case cannot execute under current product/authority/environment prerequisites.

evidence_inventory.scope: Five immutable release assets; Developer ID, notarization/staple/Gatekeeper and descriptor/package bindings; not installed E2E.
Source Quality/Security/coverage and protected CI; not installed E2E.
Exact frozen artifact inspection; not new app bytes or runtime proof.
Historical debug qualification is a separate private evidence class. No private receipt or host result is published by this documentary increment; it cannot qualify public0.4.10 cases.

blockers.CURRENT_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT: Current lifecycle admission retains historical Forge2.7.37/38/39 and EP2.3.106, not the selected Forge2.8.1/EP2.3.113 pairing baseline. Owning release/consumer qualification required; never broaden by version alone.
blockers.FORGE_CLI_RESTORE: CLI restore execution currently accepts engineering-platform-server only. Forge restore is a requirement, not a shipped CLI operation. BOTH restore requires complete admitted component orchestration.
blockers.INSTALLATION_DETACH: Legacy project-scoped detach/revocation cannot substitute for project-free installation-scoped teardown. Producer availability and installer integration require exact fresh qualification.
blockers.REPAIR_SCOPE: Repair planning/source is not completed installation-scope repair execution; classify each fault and owning contract.
blockers.PROVIDER_TOOL_UPGRADE: No dedicated provider-tool-upgrade CLI command is confirmed. Tool preparation and reauthorization do not prove this operation.
blockers.REMOTE_BINDING: Different-host binding/auth/identity and interrupted remote reconciliation need actual evidence; same-host bootstrap consent is not cross-host credential permission.
blockers.PUBLIC_UPDATE_QUALIFICATION: Historical debug product update proof does not establish public0.4.10 execution or arbitrary newer transitions.
blockers.HELPER_FIRST_RUN: Package artifacts qualified; actual clean first-start/admin/installed helper/IPC/readiness still requires E2E.
blockers.HISTORICAL_RECOVERY: Unknown historical effects and release/session drift require supported reconciliation; never clear uncertainty or replace operation IDs.
blockers.CLEAN_HOST_QUALIFICATION_PENDING: Published artifact proof exists; authorized clean public CLI/GUI host execution and reset readback remain required.

families.label: Clean installation
families.precondition: Selected component roots, jobs and inventory absent; approved clean host.
procedure: Read-only preflight; review exact selected catalog artifacts and owner.
Prepare helper, managed tools and selected provider contexts; install selected products.
Pair only if both targets are available; independently read each product.
expected: Exact selected paths, versions/digests, identities, services and readiness match the reviewed plan.
No project registration; no implicit second component or sibling mutation.

families.label: Add the second component
families.precondition: Exactly one selected component already installed and healthy.
procedure: Inventory existing identity/data/provider state; review ADD_COMPONENT for missing product.
Install only the second component; then pair and independently verify both.
expected: Existing product identity/data/provider state preserved; second component is real installed product.
Pairing occurs after second installation, without registering a project.

families.label: Pair components on different Macs
families.precondition: Independently installed selected peers on separately authorized hosts.
procedure: Verify supported discovery/configured binding and exact remote identity/authentication.
Use product-owned connection route; read both ends.
expected: No accidental local peer installation or cross-machine credential-copy assumption.
Both identities, transport authorization, binding and readiness proven.

families.label: Product upgrade
families.precondition: Exact supported installed-to-candidate artifacts and owning assessments; no concurrent lifecycle.
procedure: Capture target/sibling data and identities; review owning assessment and backups.
Execute each product-owned update with durable phases; verify after each phase.
Independently verify final versions, data, providers, pairing and readiness.
expected: Only selected product(s) changed; partial dual update never becomes a false completed pair.
Migration and rollback/recovery semantics follow exact product contract; no arbitrary version jump.

families.label: Already-current product
families.precondition: Target already matches exact reviewed release.
procedure: Assess and execute supported no-change handling.
expected: No service stop, schema/data mutation or duplicate update receipt; readiness retained.

families.label: Repair current installation
families.precondition: Owned target has a classified, supported recoverable fault; snapshot its identity/data.
procedure: Review exact fault and repair scope; invoke only owning repair contract.
Read terminal receipt and current services, provider and pairing state.
expected: Same target identity/data retained; no purge or silent reinstall fallback.
Unsupported repair remains blocked with honest explanation.

families.label: Uninstall software while retaining data
families.precondition: Installed selected component(s); supported lifecycle and installation-scope teardown admission.
procedure: Review exact target and PRESERVE; revoke/detach selected binding through product routes when required.
Stop/remove selected software/service through owning lifecycle; read preservation record.
expected: Selected instance data/config/identity remains explicitly PRESERVED, not installed or verified-authenticated.
Other component/instances/shared provider accounts unchanged; surviving pairing status honest.

families.label: Uninstall software and selected instance data
families.precondition: Exact installed or preserved selected target; fresh destructive confirmation.
procedure: Review target root/instance and PURGE separately from preserve.
Revoke/detach required binding; owning purge; read terminal tombstone and current absence.
expected: Only exact selected roots removed; restore rejected afterward.
No shared account, sibling instance, unrelated project or journal deletion.

families.label: Restore preserved installation
families.precondition: Explicit preserved record, unchanged data/identity and supported exact owning restore contract.
procedure: Review same instance and compatible artifacts; restore initially inactive as required.
Independently reverify provider contexts; repair/start through owning routes; revalidate pairing.
expected: Same opaque instance IDs and data/config; both ready only after independently verified continuation.
Corrupt/missing preservation evidence cannot become a new successful restore.

families.label: Clean install after purge
families.precondition: Owning tombstone/absence verified for prior selected instance.
procedure: Review a genuine new installation and selected artifacts.
Install and verify new identities, provider contexts and optional pairing.
expected: No old data/config/provider/pairing resurrection; old preserved restore rejected.
New instance identity is not silently substituted into an old operation.

families.label: Initial provider authentication
families.precondition: Reviewed selected provider targets; statuses only, no credential contents.
procedure: Group selected same-installation Codex targets into one human ceremony if authentication is needed.
Dispatch only via approved bounded helper bootstrap; EP GitHub separate.
Independently verify each selected target and leave healthy nonselected contexts untouched.
expected: One human Codex ceremony for selected group, not two hidden ceremonies.
No Forge GitHub provider; no manual credentials, secret logging or existing-host-to-new-host cache copy.
Copy button/selectable displayed code works only after explicit user action.

families.label: Expired/revoked provider reauthorization
families.precondition: Reviewed selected provider targets; statuses only, no credential contents.
procedure: Group selected same-installation Codex targets into one human ceremony if authentication is needed.
Dispatch only via approved bounded helper bootstrap; EP GitHub separate.
Independently verify each selected target and leave healthy nonselected contexts untouched.
expected: One human Codex ceremony for selected group, not two hidden ceremonies.
No Forge GitHub provider; no manual credentials, secret logging or existing-host-to-new-host cache copy.
Copy button/selectable displayed code works only after explicit user action.

families.label: Provider status/configuration repair
families.precondition: Reviewed selected provider targets; statuses only, no credential contents.
procedure: Group selected same-installation Codex targets into one human ceremony if authentication is needed.
Dispatch only via approved bounded helper bootstrap; EP GitHub separate.
Independently verify each selected target and leave healthy nonselected contexts untouched.
expected: One human Codex ceremony for selected group, not two hidden ceremonies.
No Forge GitHub provider; no manual credentials, secret logging or existing-host-to-new-host cache copy.
Copy button/selectable displayed code works only after explicit user action.

families.label: Upgrade provider tooling
families.precondition: Exact installed/candidate provider-tool runtime admission and reviewed selected targets.
procedure: Assess supported tool release separately from login/reauthorization.
Execute only an independently admitted tooling-update route; verify executable version/digest and account status.
expected: Do not call reauthentication a tooling upgrade; no token refresh implementation claim.
Preserve bounded authentication where owning contract allows; unsupported route remains unavailable.

families.label: Provider partial-state and cancellation handling
families.precondition: Independently observed reviewed provider targets and classified actual status; no credential contents.
procedure: Reuse verified admitted contexts without another human login.
When needed, run only one selected-group Codex ceremony, independently verify each target, and preserve healthy nonselected contexts.
Exercise cancellation/expiry through the official flow; retain the original operation and do not fabricate readiness.
expected: All-verified targets produce zero unnecessary ceremonies; partial readiness is not all-target readiness.
User cancellation, device-code timeout and unsupported provider remain honest blocked/cancelled states, not successful installation.
No automatic blind reauthentication or existing-host credential transplant.

families.label: Connect installed peers
families.precondition: Both exact selected components installed; supported connection authority.
procedure: Review both identities, named operator and installation-scoped authorization.
Configure and independently read both sides without a project.
expected: Binding tied to actual installed component identities; both readiness proven.
A missing/unready peer does not produce a paired-ready receipt.

families.label: Disconnect installed peers
families.precondition: Exact live installation-scoped binding; product-owned revoke/detach contracts.
procedure: Capture generation and scope; journal each product-owned stage with same operation IDs.
Confirm remote revoke/detach before installer credential cleanup; read both ends.
expected: Products/data remain intact; selected installation credential revoked; unrelated authorizations untouched.
Unreachable peer/lost response remains unresolved until owning status proves completion.

families.label: Repair/reconnect installed peers
families.precondition: Existing selected pairing absent/broken; exact reviewed installation scope.
procedure: Assess fault; retain product identities; repair using qualified owning authority.
Independently re-read binding, generation, credential scope and readiness.
expected: No invented project, root substitute for named operator, or stale generation acceptance.

families.label: Update installer
families.precondition: Verified public installer release; existing user session and history preserved.
procedure: Check public V1 primary and mandatory signed exact-bound helper companion.
Review self-update; hand off only validated successor; resume selected session safely.
expected: Exact downloaded app/package hashes, both signatures, independent replay anchors and provenance.
No product/provider mutation from self-update alone; no journal/uncertainty erasure.

families.label: Helper onboarding and lifecycle
families.precondition: Review actual app/team/source, helper namespace and authorized root ownership.
procedure: Use supported installer-owned administrator authorization; independently verify installed helper.
Check job/process identity and authenticated IPC before product actions.
expected: No manual Login Items setup; no fabricated security approval or raw helper-control bypass.
Repeated setup leaves one admitted helper; existing incompatible namespace fails safely until reviewed migration.

families.label: Headless service continuity
families.precondition: Real installed/readiness evidence and separately authorized reboot/logout.
procedure: Record IDs/services/data; cold reboot without interactive login.
Verify selected services, actual paths, mount dependencies, provider and pairing state.
expected: No logged-in session required for services; configured data volume mounted by verified identity.
No false readiness from stale port, receipt or unrelated process.

families.label: Interrupt and resume
families.precondition: Reviewed deterministic interruption point and durable original operation/effects.
procedure: Interrupt only within separate authorized test scope; preserve request and history.
Resume/status same operation through supported route; independently read actual products.
expected: No duplicate install, migration, auth dispatch or destructive effect; terminal replay equivalent.
Uncertain/unknown effects remain blocked unless owning current readback supports reconciliation.

families.label: Target and concurrency isolation
families.precondition: Two owned isolated targets plus independently snapshotted nonselected state.
procedure: Attempt selected install/update/repair/remove/provider action and conflicting operation.
Compare selected receipts and nonselected data/identities/services/account state.
expected: No machine-wide singleton assumptions; conflicting operations refused before mutation.
Nonselected component/instances/accounts byte/state unchanged.

families.label: Operator privilege and ownership
families.precondition: Actual OS accounts, no hardcoded personal username or fake administrator metadata.
procedure: Run installer in each context; inspect real authorization/denial and target ownership.
expected: Actual named operator binding; EP service account automatically prepared for selected instance.
Non-admin/root behavior follows admitted policy; no bypass through sudo or copied credentials.

families.label: Cache and managed-tool resilience
families.precondition: Actual reviewed artifact and tool identities; cache is acceleration only.
procedure: Exercise missing/corrupt/stale cache and network/storage faults.
Fetch/reconstruct and verify through supported route where possible; read honest blocked result otherwise.
expected: Cache alone never defines installability; no manual cache surgery prerequisite.
No accepting corrupt bytes or changed artifact; offline/space constraints are explicit genuine blockers.

families.label: Fail-closed evidence and targeting
families.precondition: Known invalid selected input; real runtime only when separately authorized.
procedure: Submit classified invalid request/evidence through selected interface.
expected: Refused before unauthorized effect; no credential content or data deletion.
Valid unrelated session/targets remain usable; no false completion.

families.label: GUI usability and honest progress
families.precondition: Real published GUI on clean authorized test host; redacted captures only.
procedure: Exercise actual buttons, selection, backward navigation and blocked/error transitions.
Validate copied displayed code, language/theme/scale, destructive confirmation and final summary.
expected: Clipboard only explicit displayed-code copy; no credentials in captures.
Progress/summary represent actual completed effects; selected plan matches CLI semantics.
